scope: Independent finite browser-zone successor admission review, static only; no release, complete owner or security qualification

findings.detail: Full physical sweep occurs before and after the entire callback loop, not after each supplied callback as specified. A callback on member B can modify already-consumed member A, while a later callback on member C restores A; B and C remain unchanged, so their per-member physical/provided/physical checks and the final sweep pass. Add full physical validation after every callback and exercise transient cross-member mutation.

The source inspector reads package.json through the supplied callback before the zone helper authenticates its image, packet and cold bound scope. The proposal inspector constructs tools and invokes the source inspector before its own zone construction. If the stated before-any-callback requirement applies to the composed entry points, these paths permit callbacks before the zone cold proof. Establish the contract and cold-check before callbacks when required.

Each guard invokes zone.assertCurrent before later tools/source/bound callbacks, with no final zone physical check. A subsequent callback can mutate a previously consumed zone member and the overall guard can return without detecting it. Protect the zone scope across all later supplied callbacks, with callback-free cold/final sweeps as appropriate.

observations: The helper reconstructs exact old/new Git bytes through packet offsets, compares each to pinned hash and size, returns current refs and no historical reader, and separately checks loaded image against its physical file.

The inspectors read the historic browser-required-cells successor from Git only for their old packet's reconstruction; current zone bytes enter bound via the helper. No new cached verdict or supplied-reader grant was found in the reviewed change.
Existing source enrollment is stale and tests were not executed. The profile candidate is a dry run and is not an admission.
